tell: Taro in the wet ground at the water's edge feeds more than any grain and the silt keeps the soil, but it grows slowly, only low and wet, and it is heavy work to lift.
suits: clamp(1 - parcel.water / 2.5, 0, 1) * clamp(field.damp * 1.3 - 0.2, 0, 1) * clamp(1 - parcel.elevation / 8, 0, 1) * (1 - field.snow)
